calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-05-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Lois Jones.
Petitioner: Rosa Maria Marcelino, present in pro per and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Humberto Maldonado Marcelino, and with Spanish Interpreter: Mikiya Matsuda.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Order granting request Dispensing Notice to the minor's father: Humberto Maldonado, granted in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Humberto Maldonado-Marcelino.
Decree signed in open court.
